metric_definitions.recall: mean fraction of required evidence groups recalled in top-k
metric_definitions.precision: mean relevant retrieved chunks divided by k
metric_definitions.ndcg: mean binary chunk-relevance nDCG at k
metric_definitions.critical_recall: mean evidence-group recall over critical cases
